notes.title: Mana's Manual Steam Next Fest limited time trial event.
notes.content:
Welcome to the Mana's Manual Steam Next Fest limited time trial event.
The campaign runs from 5 February to 12 February.
At the end of the event, the top 20 players on the leaderboard will receive a release cdkey.
